name: TalkDesk
description_en:
Talkdesk combines a cloud contact centre with separately scoped customer-experience automation products such as Copilot,Autopilot and Navigator. Its CX Cloud editions distinguish digital-only,voice,workforce and industry packages. A label such as AI-powered does not establish that all AI interactions,telephony and third-party modules are included in one seat price.

For an illustrative outbound follow-up,an administrator creates a preview campaign,sets record time zones,retries and suppression,then agents review records before calling. Connected calls can schedule campaign-aware callbacks whose ownership and remaining work need separate reporting. No account,campaign,call,AI action,callback,list operation,CRM connection,purchase or export was executed.
description_zh:
Talkdesk结合云联络中心与单独定义范围的客户体验自动化产品，例如Copilot、Autopilot及Navigator。CX Cloud版本区分纯数字、语音、劳动力及行业套餐；AI赋能标签不证明全部AI互动、电话及第三方模块都含在同一座席价。

假设外呼跟进由管理员建预览活动，设记录时区、重试及屏蔽，客服再预览拨号。已接通电话可预约关联活动回拨，责任和余项需独立报表。未执行账户、活动、电话、AI动作、回拨、名单操作、CRM连接、购买或导出。

core_features.explanation_en: Use manual dialing or automatic connection after preview timeout,with campaign priorities,hours,attempts and dispositions.
core_features.explanation_zh: 使用手动拨号或预览超时自动接通，配置活动优先级、时间、次数及处置。

core_features.explanation_en: Callbacks follow the source campaign’s agents,hours,DNC and retry strategy.
core_features.explanation_zh: 回拨遵循源活动的客服、时间、DNC及重试策略。

core_features.explanation_en: Track pending callbacks,final closure reasons and attempts that include callback work.
core_features.explanation_zh: 跟踪待回拨、最终关闭原因及包含回拨工作的尝试数。

core_features.name_en: Separate CX Cloud and CXA scope
core_features.explanation_en: Select digital/voice/workforce editions and separately confirm assistant,autonomous-agent and routing AI usage.
core_features.explanation_zh: 选择数字／语音／劳动力版本，并另核助手、自主客服及路由AI用量。

en: An outbound supervisor controlling preparation time,retries and scheduled follow-up ownership.
A contact-centre team comparing channel/workforce packages with separate AI automation costs.
zh: 控制准备时间、重试和预约跟进责任的外呼主管。
比较渠道／劳动力套餐与独立AI自动化成本的联络中心团队。
use_cases.basis: Editorial fit,not verified productivity,abandonment,AI accuracy or compliance.

Dialer prerequisites.en: Guide requires Talkdesk Dialer installed,Talkdesk Conversations and an administrator account for campaign setup. Record calling hours follow each record time zone.
Dialer prerequisites.zh: 指南要求安装Talkdesk Dialer、使用Conversations并由管理员配置，拨号时间按各记录时区。

steps.en: Choose the actual edition,AI usage scope,carrier and committed license quantities;verify Dialer/Conversations access.
steps.zh: 选择真实版本、AI用量范围、运营商及承诺许可量，核对Dialer／Conversations访问。

steps.en: Create one preview campaign with permitted records,time zones,caller ID,global/custom retries and the intended DNC list.
steps.zh: 用获准记录、时区、主叫号码、全局／自定义重试及目标DNC名单建一个预览活动。

steps.en: Test one connected callback,no-agent case,DNC conflict and reporting lifecycle before scaling;export before the contract ends.
steps.zh: 扩量前测已接通回拨、无客服、DNC冲突及报表生命周期，合同结束前导出。

items.en: Removing a record list from a campaign does not stop previously scheduled callbacks;they remain subject to campaign state and rules.
items.zh: 从活动移除名单不会停止已预约回拨，仍受活动状态及规则约束。

items.en: Myself callback assignment can fall back to another available agent in the same campaign and cannot target a ring group or team.
items.zh: Myself回拨可兜底同活动其他可用客服，不能指定振铃组或团队。

items.en: Preview guide caps20record lists and1DNC list per campaign despite an earlier as-many-lists tip. Automatic destination-based CLI adaptation is not supported there.
items.zh: 预览指南虽早说任意多名单，后明确每活动20记录名单及一个DNC；该页不支持按目的地自动改主叫。

items.en: Predictive call direction classification changed regionally in2026without historical backfill,so time-series comparisons need a consistent basis.
items.zh: 预测电话方向分类于2026按地区更正且不回填历史，时间序列需一致口径。

items.en: Seat prices omit separately metered AI,minutes,numbers,SMS,transcription and possible professional-service fees.
items.zh: 座席价不含独立计量AI、分钟、号码、短信、转录及可能实施费用。

license.notes_zh: 可撤销、有限、非独占、不可再许可及转移内部企业服务访问，Talkdesk保留平台知识产权。

pricing.source_snapshot_zh: Digital Essentials85、Voice Essentials105、Elite165、Industry Clouds225 USD／用户／月，政府定制。CXA模块另询价，无固定AI费率。MSA许可按年预付、按购买量而非用量、期内不减量、一般不退；AI互动、分钟、号码访问、短信／转录另按年度用量承诺或月后付。Express仅美加少于50员工、25许可和100余额无合同优惠，不是无限免费通话或明确试用期。真实订单最低量、税／运营商／费率未知。

faq.question_en: Will detaching a list cancel its scheduled callbacks?
faq.question_zh: 解除名单关联会取消预约回拨吗？
faq.answer_en: No. The callback guide explicitly says existing callbacks can still launch. They require the original campaign running and valid calling-hours/DNC conditions;deleting records or campaigns has a different effect.
faq.answer_zh: 不会。指南明确既有回拨仍可发起，需要原活动运行且满足时间／DNC；删除记录或活动效果不同。

faq.question_en: Does Connected Date mean a record is fully finished?
faq.question_zh: Connected Date代表记录完全完成吗？
faq.answer_en: October2026release notes define it as first answer. Final closure includes scheduled callbacks,and Total Attempts includes callback attempts;use lifecycle state and closed reason as well.
faq.answer_zh: 2026年十月说明将其定义为首次接听，最终关闭需含预约回拨，总尝试含回拨次数，应一起看生命周期及关闭原因。

sections.title_en: Price channels and AI automation separately
sections.title_zh: 分别核对渠道及AI自动化价
sections.en:
Talkdesk distinguishes CX Cloud contact-centre editions from CXA modules such as Copilot,Autopilot,Navigator,Identity and interaction analytics. Digital Essentials publishes85USD/user/month,Voice Essentials105,Elite165,and Industry Experience Clouds225,with government custom pricing. Digital engagement is not a substitute for a voice entitlement. Elite adds workforce/reporting functions,but the actual order and add-ons still define what is licensed.

The current CXA pricing page asks for a scoped quote rather than publishing one rate for every AI action. Vendor examples of autonomous card authorization or improved customer outcomes were not executed or independently verified. Express is a separate US/Canada offer for businesses under50employees,with25licenses and100dollars credit;that limited offer does not prove indefinite free carrier/AI use or a universal enterprise trial.
sections.zh:
Talkdesk区分CX Cloud联络中心版本与Copilot、Autopilot、Navigator、Identity及互动分析等CXA模块。Digital Essentials公开85 USD／用户／月，Voice Essentials105、Elite165、Industry Experience Clouds225，政府定制。数字互动不能替代语音权益；Elite加劳动力／报表，但真实订单及附加项仍定义许可。

当前CXA价格页要求按范围询价，不给所有AI动作统一费率。自主卡授权或客户改善样例未执行或独立验证。Express另限美加少于50员工，25许可加100美元余额，这不证明运营商／AI永久免费或通用企业试用。

sections.title_en: Preview can connect automatically after its timer
sections.title_zh: 预览可在倒计时后自动接通
sections.en:
The September2026preview guide requires Dialer installed,Conversations and an administrator. Automatic strategy gives the agent a configured preview timeout before connecting;Manual leaves dialing to the agent. Campaign priority ranges1–10,with10highest;ring time is6–120seconds,global attempts1–100and maximum skips up to20. Calling hours use each record’s time zone. Custom system-disposition retries override the global defaults;unconfigured dispositions use the global attempt/retry settings.

A preview label therefore does not always mean the agent explicitly starts every call. Test an expiring preview,skipped record,busy/no-answer and missing configuration. Campaigns must reach Ready before starting. The guide ultimately limits each campaign to20record lists and one DNC list,despite an earlier as-many-lists tip. DNC entries can expire,and the page says caller ID does not automatically adapt to each called destination through the campaign local-presence feature. None of those controls proves contact permission.
sections.zh:
2026年九月预览指南要求已装Dialer、Conversations及管理员。Automatic给客服配置预览倒计时后接通，Manual由客服拨号。活动优先1–10，10最高；振铃6–120秒，全局尝试1–100，最大跳过20次。时间按各记录时区，自定义系统处置重试覆盖全局，未配处置用全局次数及间隔。

因此预览不总代表每通都由客服明确启动，应测倒计时、跳过、忙线／无人接及缺配置。活动需Ready才启动。指南最终限每活动20记录名单及一个DNC，虽前有任意多名单提示。DNC可过期，且页面称活动local presence不按每个被叫自动改主叫；这些控制不证明联系许可。

sections.title_en: Scheduled callbacks remain bound to their source campaign
sections.title_zh: 预约回拨始终绑定源活动
sections.en:
A Dialer callback can be created only from a connected preview or predictive call. It stays associated with the original campaign,including callbacks scheduled from another callback. Only one active callback is allowed per record per campaign. Execution requires the campaign running and respects its calling hours and DNC list. A later calling-hours conflict moves the callback to the next valid window;a DNC conflict deletes it without launch.

Detaching a record list does not stop callbacks already scheduled;deleting the campaign or record prevents their launch. Myself(if available) first tries the scheduling agent,then falls back to another available agent in the same campaign. No eligible agent means waiting for eligibility,not guaranteed execution exactly on time. Ring groups and specific teams are not supported targets. Dialer callbacks use campaign retries rather than a generic fixed retry schedule. These are operational rules to validate before promising a customer a named-person callback.
sections.zh:
Dialer回拨只能从已接通预览或预测电话创建，始终关联原活动，回拨中再预约也一样。每记录每活动仅一个活跃回拨，发起需活动运行，并遵循活动时间及DNC。后改时间冲突移到下个合法窗口，DNC冲突删除且不发起。

解除记录名单关联不停止既有预约，删除活动或记录则阻止发起。Myself先尝试预约客服，不可用兜底同活动其他客服；无人合资格就等待，不保证准时。不能指定振铃组或团队，重试用活动策略而非通用固定重试。这些规则需在承诺客户指定人回拨前验证。

sections.title_en: A first answer and final closure measure different work
sections.title_zh: 首次接听与最终关闭衡量不同工作
sections.en:
October14,2026release notes introduce Record State values OPEN,RETRY,PENDING FOR CALLBACK and CLOSED,plus Closed Reason. Active callbacks leave the closure reason and timestamp blank;final closure includes completion of associated callbacks. Connected Date is the first answer,and Total Attempts includes callback attempts. A report can therefore show an answered record with remaining work. Use the lifecycle state rather than counting first answers as fully completed follow-up.

The same release history documents a2026predictive-call direction correction in Contacts and Activities,deployed June29in Canada,June30in Europe and July1in the US,without historical backfill. Outbound counts can change because classification changed,not because agents suddenly made more calls. August bulk actions are asynchronous and can partially fail with downloadable record-level logs. A202Accepted deletion response is also not proof of completion. No deletion or reporting query was performed;tenant availability remains to be checked.
sections.zh:
2026年十月14日说明新增OPEN、RETRY、PENDING FOR CALLBACK、CLOSED及关闭原因。活跃回拨使关闭原因及时间留空，最终关闭含关联回拨完成。Connected Date为首次接听，Total Attempts含回拨尝试。因此记录已接听仍可有余项，不能把首次接听数当完整跟进完成。

同一历史记载2026预测电话在Contacts及Activities方向更正，加拿大六月29、欧洲六月30、美国七月1部署，不回填历史。外呼计数变化可能是分类改变，而非客服忽然多拨。八月批量操作异步，可部分失败并下载逐记录日志，202Accepted删除响应也不是完成证明。未删除或查询报表，租户实际可用性待核。

sections.title_en: Committed licenses and export rights have separate clocks
sections.title_zh: 承诺许可及导出权使用不同期限
sections.en:
The MSA grants limited,revocable,nonexclusive,nontransferable service access for internal business use. Unless an order says otherwise,licenses are purchased quantities,paid annually in advance,non-cancelable and generally non-refundable,and cannot decrease during the service term. AI interactions,call minutes,number access,SMS and transcription can be metered separately. Annual usage commitments cannot automatically pay license or professional-service fees. Automatic renewal is equal-length unless disabled on the order or nonrenewal notice arrives at least30days before expiry.

Customer Data can be exported during the service term and for30days afterward;after that period the vendor may delete it under its standard procedures,subject to law. A download deadline is not a tested complete archive or restore. AppConnect and other third-party products have separate terms and data access,and integration continuity is not guaranteed. Talkdesk is an editorial candidate for teams able to own campaign states,callback staffing,commercial scope and exit exports. Actual AI rates,carrier charges,retention,regions,UI languages,order minimums and complete portability remain unverified.
sections.zh:
MSA授予有限可撤销、非独占、不可转移内部企业服务访问。除订单另写，许可按购买量、按年预付、不可取消且一般不退，服务期不能减量。AI互动、分钟、号码访问、短信及转录可另计量，年度用量承诺不能自动支付许可或实施。除订单关闭自动续或到期至少30天前通知不续，按等长期限续约。

服务期及结束后30天可导出Customer Data，之后厂商可按程序删除，依法除外。下载期限不是已测完整档案或恢复。AppConnect及其他第三方产品另有条款和资料访问，不保证集成一直可用。编辑判断适合能负责活动状态、回拨人员、商业范围及退出导出的团队。真实AI费、运营商费、留存、地区、界面语言、订单最低量及完整可携性未核。
